description:
Add a new flight authorization record through the Aerobridge Django admin panel.

1. Log in to the admin panel at http://localhost:8000/admin/ with username 'admin' and password 'adminpass123'.
2. Navigate to the 'Authorization' section under the 'Registry' group.
3. Click 'Add Authorization' and fill in the following details:
   - Title: Mumbai Port Area BVLOS Survey Authorization
   - Operation max height: 400
   - Operation ceiling: 500
   - Airspace type: Select 'Green' (the first/lowest-risk option)
   - Permit to fly above crowd: Unchecked (No)
   - Operator: Select the first available operator from the dropdown
   - Risk type: Select the first available option
   - Authorization type: Select the first available option
   - Start date: 2024-06-01 00:00:00
   - End date: 2024-12-31 23:59:00

4. After filling in all fields, click Save. A new Authorization record should appear in the admin list.

metadata.expected_title: Mumbai Port Area BVLOS Survey Authorization
